result.situation: CASE-1081: Dupixent for adult atopic dermatitis, pended by Northwind (CLIN-INFO) on 2026-10-16 because severity was not documented; the payer wants an IGA score or BSA%. Our chart notes record no IGA or BSA. First submission. 278 hours remain before the window closes 2026-10-30 23:59.

criteria.criterion: Moderate-to-severe AD documented by IGA ≥ 3 or BSA ≥ 10%
criteria.evidence: The PA form says 'moderate-severe, widespread' and the 09/2026 exam notes 'extensive eczematous plaques', but neither records an IGA score or BSA%. Severity cannot be inferred from the narrative.

criteria.criterion: Prescriber is a dermatologist, allergist or immunologist
criteria.evidence: Dr. Hannah Okafor, Allergy & Immunology; the PA form lists the prescriber as an allergist.

criteria.criterion: Topical corticosteroid (medium to super-high potency) for ≥ 28 consecutive days, with drug, dates and outcome
criteria.evidence: Clobetasol 0.05% ointment 02/10/2026-03/24/2026, inadequate response. Chart notes include the trial with outcome. The payer did not pend on step therapy.

criteria.criterion: Topical calcineurin inhibitor for ≥ 28 consecutive days, with drug, dates and outcome
criteria.evidence: Pimecrolimus 1% cream 04/01/2026-05/15/2026, inadequate response, documented in chart notes with outcome.

criteria.criterion: Not used with another biologic or JAK inhibitor for AD
criteria.evidence: The PA form states 'No concurrent biologic'. JAK inhibitor use is not addressed in any provider record.

missing_information.item: IGA score or BSA% from a dated provider exam
missing_information.why_it_matters: This is the only reason for the pend. The diagnosis criterion requires IGA ≥ 3 or BSA ≥ 10%.
missing_information.how_to_get: Request a chart note or addendum with the IGA and/or BSA from Dr. Okafor's office (Metro Allergy Partners).

missing_information.item: Confirmation that no JAK inhibitor is being used for AD
missing_information.why_it_matters: Criterion 4 excludes concurrent JAK inhibitors; the records only rule out a biologic.
missing_information.how_to_get: Ask the office to confirm this in the same records request.

E1.reason: No contraindication or intolerance call and no lab interpretation is needed. The payer needs a documented score from the provider, not our interpretation of the exam (DOC-1081-02, CASE).

E2.reason: Sources agree on trials and diagnosis. NOTE-1 is consistent with DOC-1081-01 and DOC-1081-02.

E3.reason: KB-0002 is a tip about triamcinolone, not a reported rule change, and it does not apply to this case (clobetasol was used). POLICY's last bulletin shows no changes.

E4.reason: 278 hours are left; the system shows the deadline is not at risk (CASE, POLICY 14-day pend window).

E5.reason: This is a first submission and a pend, not a second denial (CASE).

E6.reason: No patient safety concern appears in CASE, DOC-1081-01, DOC-1081-02 or NOTE-1.

result.action_rationale: The CLIN-INFO pend maps to REQUEST_RECORDS because we do not hold the severity score. The chart notes (DOC-1081-02) explicitly have no IGA or BSA, and the narrative 'extensive' cannot substitute for one. Step-therapy documents already look complete. No trigger fires, and the window has ample time.
parallel_actions: Pre-assemble the resubmission packet: PA form plus step-therapy chart notes (DOC-1081-01, DOC-1081-02).
Set a 48-hour follow-up with the provider office per SOP.
Log the action and the criteria checklist in case notes.
could_not_determine: The patient's actual IGA score or BSA%.
Whether the patient is on a JAK inhibitor for AD.
needs_human_judgment: If the office cannot provide a documented IGA or BSA before about 2026-10-28, decide whether to escalate to the Team Lead under the deadline rule.

draft.to: Dr. Hannah Okafor / Metro Allergy Partners
draft.subject: CASE-1081 – Dupixent PA pended: IGA or BSA needed
draft.body:
Hello,

Northwind Health Plan pended the Dupixent PA for patient PT-59930 (case CASE-1081) on 10/16/2026. Reason: atopic dermatitis severity is not documented.

Please send:
1. A dated chart note or addendum recording the Investigator's Global Assessment (IGA) score and/or body surface area (BSA %) involved. The 09/2026 exam note describes extensive plaques but gives no score.
2. Confirmation that the patient is not using a JAK inhibitor for AD.

No other records are needed; we already have the step-therapy documentation. Northwind's response window closes 10/30/2026, so please reply as soon as you can, ideally within 2 business days.

Thank you,
Forus Access Operations
